Entry of Foreign Universities
*361. SHRI JESUDASU SEELAM:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether a high powered ministerial
panel is on the cards to decide on entry of
foreign universities into the country in the
light of the stringent recommendations
made by an expert committee headed by
noted scientists;
(b) if so, whether this matter is to be
considered by a Group of Ministers before
it is placed before the Cabinet;
(c) if so, by when the panel is likely to
submit its recommendations;
(d) whether Government is also
considering that those universities which
offer some form of joint ventures including
business opportunities should be
entertained; and
(e) if so, by when Government are
likely to take a decision thereon?
National Urban Renewal Mission
†*362. SHRIMATI KUM KUM
RAI:
SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the cities included under the
Jawaharlal Nehru National Urban Renewal
Mission;
(b) the cities where work under the
Mission is already underway;
(c) the amount allocated for the said
project during the current financial year;
and
(d) the status of covering mega cities in
Orissa for development of the
infrastructure with a view to improve the
economy of this backward region?
Sub-standard electric equipments and
sanitary ware in government flats
†*363. SHRI AJAY SINGH
CHAUTALA: Will the Minister of
URBAN DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that in the government flats in
Delhi, sub-standard electric equipments and
sanitarywares have been provided;
(b) the number of complaints of this
nature received during the last six months;
and
(c) the action Government are initiating
against the guilty officers?
Education system and unemployment
†*364. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA: W ill the Minister of
HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
the present education system in the
country is creating large scale unemploy-
ment and no priority has been given to the
requirements of the industry and trade;
(b) if so, whether a job oriented
education system is proposed to be
introduced; and
(c) if so, the time limit fixed in this regard
and the details of various aspects which
would be taken care of?
Outflow of IIT graduates to foreign
countries
*365. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any plans
to set up IITs in foreign countries;
(b) whether it is a fact that a large number
of IIT graduates migrate immediately after
their studies at IITs;
(c) the extent to which Government are
thinking of encouraging such an outflow of
the students;
(d) whether the high cost of education
at IITs being borne by Government is not
helping the common man; and
(e) if so, the steps Government would
consider to find ways and means to ensure
that IIT students work for the country at
least for some time?
Central University for KBK region
*366. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that during a
meeting with him the Chief Minister of
Orissa has made a proposal for setting up a
Central University for the KBK region
(undivided Kalahandi, Bolangir and Koraput
Districts) of Orissa;
(b) whether Government are aware that
a Central University, in this most backward
tribal dominated region, would go a long
way in encouraging higher education among
the tribals where the literacy rate is below
50 per cent;
(c) if so, the status of the proposal; and
(d) the time-frame within which a
Central University would be set up in that
region?

 SHRI RAVI SHANKAR

Mass Rapid Transit System in
Mumbai
*368. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Government of
Maharashtra has sought Government's

participation and 50 per cent viability gap

Mass Rapid Transit System along Andheri-
Ghatkopar Corridor in Mumbai;
(b) if so, the details thereof when it was
mooted and the reasons for the delay; and
(c) whether similar support besides

Cooking equipment for mid-day meal
†*369. SHRIMATI SUSHMA
SWARAJ: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the stoves
and traditional chulhas are used to cook
food under the Mid-day Meal Scheme;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that
these equipments are not useful for cooking
food for a large number of children together
and as a result thereof women engaged in
cooking have to face problems; and
(c) whether Government would
consider to provide gas stoves and cylinders
for this purpose?
Environment friendly features in
buildings
*370. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of URBAN EMPLOYMENT
AND POVERTY ALLEVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Indian Green Building
Council has asked Government to make it
mandatory for the buildings above 20000
Sq. ft. to incorporate minimum green
features; and
(b) if so, the action taken in this regard?
Adoption laws
*371. DR. K. MALAISAMY:
SHRI C. PERUMAL:
Will the Minister of LAW AND
JUSTICE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the law for
adoption in force in the country is
inadequate and is more parent-oriented
rather than child-oriented, without taking
care of the family environment of the
adoptee;
(b) in this context, whether there is a
strong urge for comprehensive laws and
training of judicial officers to deal with inter
and intra community adoptions; and
(c) if so, the initiatives taken, if any, in
this regard?

114
Visit of Taiwanese delegation
*372. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether a huge Taiwanese business
delegation from construction industry
visited India in October, 2—9, 2005;
(b) whether delegation has also attended
a workshop organized by the local
construction companies;
(c) whether the discussion was held at
the corporate level;
(d) if so, whether any concrete
agreement between the two countries has
been signed during the visit;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) to what extent both would be able to
improve construction work?
Projects submitted to the DONER
*373. SHRI LALHMING LIANA: Will
the Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of the projects submitted
to his Ministry during 2004-05 and
2005-06; and
(b) the details of the projects sanctioned
during the said period and those pending,

Cable T.V. charges
*374. SHRI PRAMOD MAHAJAN:
Will the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Telecom Regulatory
Authority of India has decided to raise cable
T.V. charges;
(b) if so, at what rate and since when;
and
(c) the reasons therefor?
Master Plan-2021
*375. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA: Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether provisions outlined in
Master Plan-2021 for Delhi would help in
providing solutions for the regularization
of commercial activities in residential areas
and additional dwelling units all over Delhi
(especially in the Influence Zone along
metro corridor) and unauthorized colonies;
(b) if so, the details thereof and by when
it would be notified;
(c) whether Government have
informed the Hon'ble Supreme Court and
Delhi High Court about these proposals
and status of Master Plan-2021 so that
they could take into account the new
developments while giving directions in
these matters; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Visit by officials of ASI
*376. SHRI R. KAMARAJ: Will the
Minister of CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Archaeological Survey of India had recently
visited many sites in different countries to
preserve the monuments of Indian
importance there;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the response received by it from
those countries?

National Housing Policy
*377. SHRI MOOLCHAND
MEENA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the Minister of URBAN
EMPLOYMENT AND POVERTY
ALLEVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether a revamped version of the
National Housing Policy would be
presented to the Chief Ministers'
Conference;
(b) if so, whether this would be
implemented along with national roll-out
of the National Urban Renewal Mission
for an orderly development of towns and
cities;
(c) whether the Mission would provide
over Rs. 5500 crores in the first year itself
to meet gaps in housing and urban
infrastructure which would be further
stepped upto Rs. 10000 crore a year; and
(d) if so, by when it would be finally
approved and implemented?
Uniformity in education
*378. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have taken a
decision for 'One Nation-One Education'
in the country and if so, the details thereof;
(b) the States where this system would
be initiated first and by when;
(c) whether keeping in view the most
thickly populated State of Uttar Pradesh,
to what extent this system would be
beneficial; and
(d) the financial aid to be given to the
State in this regard?
Universalisation of secondary
education
*379. SHRI DARA SINGH
CHAUHAN: Will the Minister of
HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether CABE has constituted a
Committee for "Universalisation of
Secondary Education";
(b) if so, the details thereof and progress
made, so far;
(c) the steps Government propose to
take to ensure that syllabus followed by all
the Education Boards throughout the
country is the same;
(d) whether any study has been
conducted to compare the content
prescribed by various Boards and the
difficulties being faced by students who
are forced to study syllabus of different
Boards in the event of either change of
school or the State; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and if not,
whether such a study is proposed and
whether Government propose to consider
the matter in a meeting of CABE?
Population of tribals
*380. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
TRIBAL AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the tribal population in the country,
State-wise and gender-wise;
(b) the number of tribals who have been
deprived of their land so far, State-wise;
(c) the reasons therefor; and
(d) the steps to be taken by
Government to protect rights of the tribals?
